pins.title: Homeschool Nature Journal: Spot a Spiderweb After Rain
pins.description: What can a child record on a damp day? Note the weather, sketch a web you can see from the path and leave it in place. The free two-page Nature Tracker has room for five days of observations. Get the tracker with a parent, guardian or teacher email.

pins.title: Nature Drawing Game for Kids: Sketch a Clue and Guess
pins.description: How can two people turn a nature sketch into a guessing game? Choose a tiny outdoor discovery, sketch it, then describe it without using its name. Let your partner guess. Leave living things where you find them. Try the free Tiny World Hunt.
